question: Should upgrades retain and adopt existing OpenShell sandboxes that use the previous deterministic name format, or is deliberately creating a new sandbox for every existing scope acceptable?
rationale: The implementation changes a remote workspace identity rather than only its display value, and the repository policy requires an explicit compatibility or migration decision for this kind of persisted external state.

options.title: Preserve existing sandboxes
options.body: Add a plugin-owned transition that recognizes the prior deterministic ID and proves upgrades reuse the old remote sandbox before using the compact ID for new scopes.

options.title: Accept a clean break
options.body: Document that upgrades intentionally create new OpenShell sandboxes and obtain explicit maintainer approval for the workspace/state discontinuity.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing sandboxes
recommendation.body: Add a plugin-owned transition that recognizes the prior deterministic ID and proves upgrades reuse the old remote sandbox before using the compact ID for new scopes.
